$comment: HONEST BACKLOG, NOT A GATE. The build scripts under scripts/ are written as
plain .mjs with no JSDoc, so type-checking their bodies surfaces hundreds of
errors that have never been anyone's expectation. This config exists to make
that number measurable and to let it be ratcheted down, not to be forced to
It is deliberately NOT wired into `pnpm typecheck` or into CI: a permanently
failing command teaches people to ignore it. `pnpm typecheck:scripts:checkjs`
is opt-in and reports the count; see
measurement recorded when this config was added.
What IS enforced is tsconfig.scripts.json: the 23 .ts test files that guard
this pipeline, checked against the real inferred signatures of the .mjs they
import — plus tsconfig.pack-ep.json, which checks the BODIES of
scripts/pack-ep.mjs and scripts/sign-ep.mjs. Those two files no longer appear
in this config's error count, so it is a backlog of what is still unchecked
HERE, not a list of what is unchecked everywhere.
